expert.name: Aoife
expert.quote: Ireland is small enough to circle in a week and warm enough that you will want to stay longer in every pub you pass.
expert.tip: Pack layers, not an umbrella. The weather changes every hour on the west coast and the wind makes umbrellas useless on the cliffs.

summary: A week round Ireland by road: two nights in Dublin, the Rock of Cashel and Kilkenny on the way to Cork, Killarney and Adare to Limerick, the Cliffs of Moher to Galway and back across the midlands.
included: Included: all transfers and rail or ferry journeys as listed; sightseeing and cruises as listed with tickets where stated; daily breakfast.
